output_list.criticism: The function GetStats() is vulnerable to integer overflow. The variable timeToEnd is initialized to 0 and is updated with the difference between the current time and the start time. If the difference is greater than the maximum possible value of uint256, the function will return an incorrect result. This can be exploited by an attacker to manipulate the timeToEnd variable and cause the function to return an incorrect value.

The function GetMaxStageEthAmount() is vulnerable to integer overflow. The variable retVal is initialized to currS.stageSum and is updated with the product of retVal and 10**18. If the product is greater than the maximum possible value of uint256, the function will return an incorrect result. This can be exploited by an attacker to manipulate the retVal variable and cause the function to return an incorrect value.

The function GetNow() is vulnerable to integer overflow. The variable now is initialized to the current block timestamp and is used in the function GetStats(). If the block timestamp is greater than the maximum possible value of uint256, the function will return an incorrect result. This can be exploited by an attacker to manipulate the now variable and cause the function to return an incorrect value.
